review_notes: I read the whole file. The only new data-carrying declarations are the scoped TopologicalSpace and UniformSpace instances on MvPowerSeries σ R. Both are defined with inferInstanceAs from the Pi instances on (σ →₀ ℕ) → R, so they reuse the existing Mathlib concepts and do not compete with them. A grep of Mathlib for other TopologicalSpace or UniformSpace instances on MvPowerSeries found only these two. The other declarations are theorems or instance-valued theorems that derive Mathlib classes (T0, T2, topological semiring, complete space, uniform add group) from the Pi instances. The ContinuousSMul instance reuses instContinuousSMulForall. The theorem-level overlaps, such as the univariate PowerSeries pi topology and the LinearTopology file mentioned in the docstring, fall under standalone theorem duplication, which the rubric excludes. I did not check every theorem against all of Mathlib. I found no justified finding.
